reason: Provides practical access information for reaching a winter-blocked mast site, including parking location and equipment container details.

knowledge.summary: The last 500 m to the Kittilä mast site is unploughed in winter; park at the snowmobile track sign, walk the rest, and use the snowshoes inside the equipment container with padlock code 6142.
knowledge.author: Tiina Tuominen
knowledge.details: Park at the snowmobile track sign and walk the last 500 m. Snowshoes are on the left wall inside the equipment container, padlock code 6142.
